findings.title: RDS instance publicly accessible
findings.message: db (db_instance) has Publicly Accessible enabled. RDS should never be internet-facing.
findings.fix: Disable Publicly Accessible in the component config.

findings.title: Lambda function has no IAM execution role connected
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) has no IAM execution role. Lambda cannot write CloudWatch logs or call any AWS service.
findings.fix: Attach an IAM Role with AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole to this Lambda function.
findings.suggestion: Create `aws_iam_role` with trust policy for `lambda.amazonaws.com` and attach `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole`. Set `role = aws_iam_role.<name>.arn` on `aws_lambda_function`.

findings.title: EC2 IMDSv2 not enforced
findings.message: web (instance) does not enforce IMDSv2. Set metadata tokens to required to prevent SSRF attacks.
findings.fix: Set IMDSv2 (Metadata Tokens) to required in the component config.

findings.title: EC2 instance has no IAM instance profile
findings.message: web (instance) has no IAM instance profile. Applications must use hard-coded credentials for AWS API access.
findings.fix: Attach an IAM Role to this EC2 instance.
findings.suggestion: Create `aws_iam_instance_profile` referencing an `aws_iam_role` and set `iam_instance_profile` on `aws_instance`.

findings.title: EC2 instance has no IAM instance profile
findings.message: app (instance) has no IAM instance profile. Applications must use hard-coded credentials for AWS API access.
findings.fix: Attach an IAM Role to this EC2 instance.
findings.suggestion: Create `aws_iam_instance_profile` referencing an `aws_iam_role` and set `iam_instance_profile` on `aws_instance`.

findings.title: RDS storage not encrypted
findings.message: db (db_instance) does not have storage encryption enabled.
findings.fix: Enable Storage Encrypted in the component config panel.

findings.title: RDS backup retention disabled
findings.message: db (db_instance) has backup retention set to 0. Set at least 7 days.
findings.fix: Set Backup Retention to 7 or more days in the component config.

findings.title: RDS CloudWatch log exports not configured
findings.message: db (db_instance) has no CloudWatch log exports enabled. Error and audit logs are not being captured.
findings.fix: Set enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports to include error, general, and slowquery.

findings.title: S3 bucket has no server-side encryption
findings.message: logs (s3_bucket) has no server-side encryption configured.
findings.fix: Set Server-Side Encryption to AES256 or aws:kms in the component config.

findings.title: S3 bucket missing Block Public Access
findings.message: logs (s3_bucket) does not have Block Public Access enabled.
findings.fix: Enable Block Public Access in the component config.

findings.title: S3 bucket policy may allow non-SSL access
findings.message: logs (s3_bucket) has Block Public Policy disabled. An aws:SecureTransport deny policy is recommended to enforce HTTPS.
findings.fix: Enable Block Public Policy and add a bucket policy denying requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.

findings.title: Lambda function not in a VPC
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) is not configured in a VPC. Functions handling sensitive data should run in a private VPC.
findings.fix: Add a vpc_config block referencing your VPC subnets and security groups.

findings.title: RDS instance does not enforce SSL connections
findings.message: db (db_instance) does not have SSL enforcement configured. Database connections may be transmitted unencrypted.
findings.fix: Set require_ssl or attach a parameter group that enforces SSL.
findings.suggestion: Set `require_ssl = true` or reference a parameter group with `rds.force_ssl = 1`.

findings.title: No security group assigned
findings.message: web (instance) has no security group. Define explicit ingress/egress rules.
findings.fix: Open the Security tab and create or assign a security group to this component.

findings.title: Orphaned component — no connections
findings.message: web (instance) has no connections. Connect it or remove it.
findings.fix: Draw an edge from this component to a related resource, or delete it if no longer needed.

findings.fix: Open the Security tab and create or assign a security group to this component.

findings.fix: Draw an edge from this component to a related resource, or delete it if no longer needed.

findings.fix: Draw an edge from this component to a related resource, or delete it if no longer needed.

findings.title: Architecture contains data stores but no KMS key resource
findings.message: db (db_instance) and other data stores have no KMS key. Encryption uses AWS-managed keys with no audit trail or revocation capability.
findings.fix: Add a KMS Key component and reference it from data store encryption configs.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_kms_key` with `enable_key_rotation = true`. Reference CMK ARNs in each data store encryption config.

findings.title: RDS instance is single-AZ with no connection to a backup plan
findings.message: db (db_instance) is single-AZ with backup_retention_period < 7 days. An AZ failure causes extended downtime with limited recovery options.
findings.fix: Enable Multi-AZ and set backup_retention_period >= 7.
findings.suggestion: Set `multi_az = true` and `backup_retention_period = 7` on `aws_db_instance`. Add `aws_backup_plan` for longer-term retention.

findings.title: Architecture contains data stores but no KMS key resource
findings.message: logs (s3_bucket) and other data stores have no KMS key. Encryption uses AWS-managed keys with no audit trail or revocation capability.
findings.fix: Add a KMS Key component and reference it from data store encryption configs.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_kms_key` with `enable_key_rotation = true`. Reference CMK ARNs in each data store encryption config.

findings.title: AWS Config service is not present in the architecture
findings.message: No AWS Config recorder is included. Without Config you cannot track resource changes, enforce compliance rules, or audit configuration drift.
findings.fix: Add an AWS Config node to the architecture.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_config_configuration_recorder` and `aws_config_delivery_channel` to record all resource changes.

findings.title: Amazon GuardDuty is not present in the architecture
findings.message: No GuardDuty detector is included. GuardDuty provides threat detection for AWS accounts and workloads.
findings.fix: Add a GuardDuty node to the architecture.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_guardduty_detector` with `enable = true`.

findings.title: No AWS Backup plan is present in the architecture
findings.message: Stateful resources are present but no AWS Backup plan is defined. Without a backup plan, data recovery after an incident is not guaranteed.
findings.fix: Add an AWS Backup plan to the architecture and connect it to stateful resources.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_backup_plan` with a `rule` block and `aws_backup_selection` targeting stateful resources.

findings.title: CloudTrail not enabled
findings.message: No AWS CloudTrail resource found in this plan. Audit logging will not be enabled.
findings.fix: Add an aws_cloudtrail resource with multi_region_trail = true and enable_log_file_validation = true.

findings.title: No customer-managed KMS key
findings.message: No customer-managed KMS key configured on this RDS resource. PCI DSS and HIPAA require CMKs.
findings.fix: Set kms_key_id to the ARN of an aws_kms_key resource with rotation enabled.

findings.title: No customer-managed KMS key
findings.message: No customer-managed KMS key configured on this S3 resource. PCI DSS and HIPAA require CMKs.
findings.fix: Set kms_key_id to the ARN of an aws_kms_key resource with rotation enabled.

findings.title: VPC flow logs disabled
findings.message: No VPC flow log resource found. Network traffic to and from this VPC is not being logged.
findings.fix: Add an aws_flow_log resource with vpc_id referencing this VPC and traffic_type = "ALL".

findings.title: RDS deletion protection off
findings.message: db (db_instance) has no deletion protection. Enable it to prevent accidental drops.
findings.fix: Enable Deletion Protection in the component config.

findings.title: RDS instance not marked for reserved pricing
findings.message: db (db_instance) is not marked as a reserved instance. Reserved instances save 30-60% for production databases.
findings.fix: Enable Reserved Instance in the component config to document the intent.

findings.title: RDS uses gp2 storage — upgrade to gp3
findings.message: db (db_instance) uses gp2 storage. gp3 provides the same baseline IOPS at 20% lower cost.
findings.fix: Change Storage Type to gp3 in the component config.
findings.suggestion: Set `storage_type = "gp3"` on `aws_db_instance`. gp3 delivers 3000 IOPS baseline; add `iops` if you need more than 3000 (up to 16,000 on gp3).

findings.title: RDS storage autoscaling not configured
findings.message: db (db_instance) has no max_allocated_storage set. Storage must be manually resized.
findings.fix: Set Max Allocated Storage to 2–3x the initial allocation in the component config.
findings.suggestion: Set `max_allocated_storage` to 2–3x `allocated_storage` on `aws_db_instance`. RDS autoscales within this limit with zero downtime.

findings.title: RDS Performance Insights disabled
findings.message: db (db_instance) has Performance Insights disabled. Without it you cannot identify slow queries or right-size the instance.
findings.fix: Enable Performance Insights in the component config.
findings.suggestion: Set `performance_insights_enabled = true` on `aws_db_instance`. The free tier retains 7 days of data. Required for any right-sizing exercise.

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning disabled
findings.message: logs (s3_bucket) does not have versioning enabled. Enable it to protect against accidental deletes.
findings.fix: Enable Versioning in the component config.

findings.title: Lambda X-Ray tracing disabled
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) has X-Ray tracing set to PassThrough. Enable Active tracing for observability.
findings.fix: Set X-Ray Tracing to Active in the component config.

findings.title: Lambda using x86_64 — Graviton2 (arm64) is cheaper
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) uses x86_64. arm64 (Graviton2) is 20% cheaper and typically 20% faster.
findings.fix: Set Architecture to arm64 in the component config.
findings.suggestion: Set `architectures = ["arm64"]` on `aws_lambda_function`. Test with your runtime — Python, Node.js, Java, and Go support arm64 natively.

findings.title: Lambda at default 128 MB memory
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) uses the default 128 MB memory allocation. Increasing memory often reduces duration enough to lower total cost.
findings.fix: Use AWS Lambda Power Tuning to find the optimal memory/cost balance.
findings.suggestion: Run AWS Lambda Power Tuning (github.com/alexcasalboni/aws-lambda-power-tuning). Most functions are cheapest at 512 MB–1 GB, not 128 MB.

findings.title: Lambda function has no reserved concurrency limit
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) has no reserved concurrency. A traffic spike can exhaust the account concurrency pool.
findings.fix: Set Reserved Concurrency in the component config to cap parallel executions.
findings.suggestion: Set `reserved_concurrent_executions` on `aws_lambda_function` to cap runaway invocations.

findings.title: EC2 instance does not have detailed monitoring enabled
findings.message: web (instance) has monitoring = false. Detailed monitoring provides 1-minute metric resolution instead of 5-minute.
findings.fix: Enable detailed monitoring by setting monitoring = true.
findings.suggestion: Set `monitoring = true` on `aws_instance`.

findings.title: EC2 instance does not have detailed monitoring enabled
findings.message: app (instance) has monitoring = false. Detailed monitoring provides 1-minute metric resolution instead of 5-minute.
findings.fix: Enable detailed monitoring by setting monitoring = true.
findings.suggestion: Set `monitoring = true` on `aws_instance`.

findings.title: RDS IAM database authentication is not enabled
findings.message: db (db_instance) does not use IAM authentication. Password-based access lacks the auditability and rotation controls of IAM auth.
findings.fix: Enable IAM database authentication.
findings.suggestion: Set `iam_database_authentication_enabled = true` on `aws_db_instance`.

findings.title: S3 bucket does not have server access logging enabled
findings.message: logs (s3_bucket) has no access logging configured. Without logs you cannot audit who accessed or modified objects.
findings.fix: Enable server access logging on the bucket.
findings.suggestion: Add `logging { target_bucket = aws_s3_bucket.<logs>.id target_prefix = "access-logs/" }` on `aws_s3_bucket`.

findings.title: No CloudWatch monitoring
findings.message: web (instance) has no CloudWatch connection.
findings.fix: Add a CloudWatch component and connect it to this resource.

findings.title: No CloudWatch monitoring
findings.message: app (instance) has no CloudWatch connection.
findings.fix: Add a CloudWatch component and connect it to this resource.

findings.title: No CloudWatch monitoring
findings.message: db (db_instance) has no CloudWatch connection.
findings.fix: Add a CloudWatch component and connect it to this resource.

findings.title: Single AZ — no high availability
findings.message: db (db_instance) does not have Multi-AZ enabled. Enable it for production workloads.
findings.fix: Enable Multi-AZ in the component config.

findings.title: No CloudWatch monitoring
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) has no CloudWatch connection.
findings.fix: Add a CloudWatch component and connect it to this resource.

findings.title: Lambda function has no dead-letter queue
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) has no dead-letter queue. Failed async invocations will be silently dropped.
findings.fix: Add an SQS queue or SNS topic and connect it to this Lambda as a DLQ.

findings.title: EC2 instance is not connected to Systems Manager
findings.message: web (instance) has no Systems Manager connection. Without SSM you must open SSH ports for management, increasing attack surface.
findings.fix: Connect the EC2 instance to a Systems Manager node and attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_ssm_association` or attach `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` policy to the instance role. Remove SSH ingress rules.

findings.title: EC2 instance is not connected to Systems Manager
findings.message: app (instance) has no Systems Manager connection. Without SSM you must open SSH ports for management, increasing attack surface.
findings.fix: Connect the EC2 instance to a Systems Manager node and attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_ssm_association` or attach `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` policy to the instance role. Remove SSH ingress rules.

findings.title: Service does not have AWS X-Ray tracing enabled
findings.message: processor (lambda_function) has no X-Ray tracing configured. Without distributed tracing, performance issues and errors are difficult to diagnose.
findings.fix: Enable X-Ray active tracing or connect an X-Ray node.
findings.suggestion: Set `tracing_config { mode = "Active" }` on Lambda or enable X-Ray on ECS/API Gateway.

findings.title: Amazon Inspector is not present in the architecture
findings.message: Compute resources are present but no Amazon Inspector is defined. Without Inspector, container images and EC2 instances are not scanned for vulnerabilities.
findings.fix: Add Amazon Inspector to continuously scan EC2 instances and container images.
findings.suggestion: Enable `aws_inspector2_enabler` for EC2 and ECR resource types.

findings.title: AWS Security Hub is not present in the architecture
findings.message: No Security Hub is included. Security Hub aggregates findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and other services into a single security posture view.
findings.fix: Add AWS Security Hub to the architecture.
findings.suggestion: Add `aws_securityhub_account` and enable relevant standards (AWS Foundational, CIS, PCI).
